scientific_integrity: A finite-dimensional proof via Schmidt-block decomposition, rank-one Gram inequality, and Ky Fan convexity; numerical tests are supplemental, not proof.
scientific_limitations: Two identical finite-dimensional depolarizing channels; all physical complete-positivity parameters and arbitrary bipartite states. Does not address three or more uses, unequal channel parameters, or infinite dimension. Priority is based on inspected literature, not an exhaustive assertion.
title: Exact two-use majorization for depolarizing channels in every dimension
